name: Gmail
description: Your Gmail in lanes (Unread, Alerts with Grafana grouping, Read), one Google account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it). Open a thread as a clean page to discuss with Claude; with the Jira plugin, a mail from Jira shows its issue beside it. Sorted by Jev triage when installed. It only ever changes the read state: it never archives, labels, trashes or sends. Feeds Inbox 0.2.0 (inbox feed version 2). Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.1 or later (0.9.2 recommended); 0.10.0 for Inbox 0.2.0 and the overlay toolbar buttons.
author: BronOS
